name: Baiao
label: BAIAO
source: Galvao 2018 (ANPPOM, after Barreto 2012 p.177); Patitucci, Electric Bass Complete (LinkedIn Learning), Baiao; Cortes 2014 Per Musi 29; 2/4 in sixteenths; tempo a practice default

sources.title: Galvao, C. (2018), Complexizacao do baiao na bateria, ANPPOM XXVIII
sources.shows: zabumba: the first note (dotted eighth) and the fourth (sixteenth) of the first beat of a 2/4 bar are struck; the triangle fills every sixteenth

sources.title: John Patitucci, Electric Bass Complete: Baiao (LinkedIn Learning)
sources.shows: 'It basically relates to the bass drum': a dotted quarter, then an eighth on the and of two, tied to a half note (the same two attacks at double note values)

sources.title: Cortes, A. (2014), Como se toca o baiao, Per Musi 29 p.195-208
sources.shows: the triangle keeps the sixteenth subdivision; the tied figure (dotted eighth, sixteenth tied over) became the standard levada after 1949
